name: An Accra compound

place_source.title: Wikidata: Accra (Q3761), coordinate location and elevation above sea level

blurb: A walled family compound on Accra's sandy coastal plain: hard standing under a mango, a coconut and an oil palm, a low wall the egrets and laughing doves use, teak and a flame tree at the gate, a drain where a toad sits after rain. Village weavers nest under the eaves, crows and doves hold the palms, a hornbill works the mango, and fruit bats leave the trees at dusk.

facts.text: Accra has a tropical savanna climate, Köppen Aw.

facts.text: The village weaver is among the more common weaver species, widespread in sub-Saharan Africa, and the male weaves its hanging nest from strips torn from palms and large grasses.
